audit_metadata.title: Stage 2 G0 Accepted Observations Delay Resolution Audit
audit_metadata.scope: Time resolution analysis of 22 candidate observations surviving G0

simultaneous_event_rejection.reject_reason: Δt=0.00s <= 0: target did not follow source.

delay_quantization_analysis.quantization_jitter_error: ±15.0 seconds discretization jitter relative to true physical onset

raw_1hz_physical_step_up_delay_seconds.interpretation: Motorized valve opening stroke transit time

MV201_to_FIT201.discrepancy_explanation: Reported delays of 180s and 450s reflect multi-burst anomaly pairing across prolonged operational cycles rather than physical fluid transit

P101_to_FIT101.discrepancy_explanation: Pump ran for minutes before anomalous flow deviation was flagged by detector, inflating window-level onset delta

raw_1hz_physical_delay_seconds.interpretation: Concurrent system shutdown with zero physical transport lag

FIT501_to_FIT502.discrepancy_explanation: 10 candidate edges represent repeated combinations of 10 micro-bursts of FIT501 against only 2 physical target episodes in FIT502

P301_to_DPIT301.discrepancy_explanation: Delays of 420s to 570s reflect pairing of early P301 pump events to subsequent multi-stage shutdown depressurization

raw_1hz_physical_delay_seconds.interpretation: Consistent 120s pipe transit and ORP chemical probe response lag

P205_to_AIT203.discrepancy_explanation: Window-level onset quantization flagged source at 08:27:30 and target at 08:28:00 (dt=30s), underestimating the true 120s chemical transport delay

conclusions_and_recommendations.recommendation: Dynamic modeling must extract raw 1Hz time series around identified candidate intervals to estimate true continuous-time transfer functions and physical delay bounds
